messages.text: I'm thinking of getting another Nexus S4. Any deals?

Prices are as listed, no codes to give. Also worth flagging: we don't have a Nexus S4 — the Nexus line here is the S1 (10 TH/s, $699). The T. P2 on your screen is the same 10 TH/s at $379, 166 W at the wall. What do you pay per kWh?
I got your Nexus bundle S1 and L1...my BS4 is on the way from China it seems, I'd prefer another Nexus S1 over the Thor P2 so I thought I'd ask lol
Read the nexus s1 10th s page

Fair enough — no deals to give, the S1 is $699 as listed and the Thor P2 is $379.

Honest note on timing: the S1 is on batch 2, which is in transit to the warehouse and running behind, so a new one ships when that lands rather than this week. The T. P2 is the same 10 TH/s and ships now.

Want me to put an S1 in the cart anyway?
let me sleep on it. Thanks!

Sounds good — it'll be here when you're ready.

Before you go, one thing: what makes you want a second S1 rather than a different unit?
I have my mods down pretty good, and it's silent as heck running 12.5TH with front and back noctua's and a few extra mini coper heatsinks

12.5 TH silent is a solid tune.

What pushed you to mod it in the first place — the noise, or chasing the extra hashrate?
the back RBG fan was junk lol, I'm a bt of a perfectoinist, and I'd have it sitting next to the other one

Makes sense — a matched pair looks right in a way a mixed shelf doesn't.

Last one: is it the matching look that rules out the Thor P2 sitting beside it, or the spec?
Got it — thanks, that's genuinely useful. Sleep on it, and I'm here when you want that second S1 in the cart.
